gram_published.source: Baek et al. 2026, Generative Recursive Reasoning, arXiv 2605.19376, Table 1 (Sec. 4.2); mean +- SD over runs; conflicts summed over the test graphs; Cov@20 in percent
gram_published.training: 5,000 epochs, global batch 768, 8 RTX 4090 GPUs: 1.5 h (8 vertices), 6 h (10 vertices) (App. B, Table 7)

metric_definitions.proper_1: fraction of test graphs whose single output (chain 0, its first stop or its lowest-energy coloring at the cap) has no conflict, any color order
metric_definitions.proper_canonical_1: GRAM's validity of the single output: proper and in canonical color order
metric_definitions.conflicts_1: GRAM's Conflict at N = 1: conflict edges of the single output, summed over test graphs
metric_definitions.conflicts_majority_20: GRAM's Conflict at N = 20: conflict edges of the most frequent of 20 outputs (ties: lower mean energy), summed over test graphs
metric_definitions.coverage_20: GRAM's Cov@20: distinct proper canonical outputs of 20 chains, summed over graphs, over all canonical proper colorings of the test graphs
metric_definitions.coverage_canonicalized_20: as coverage_20 after relabeling each proper output into canonical order (uses color-permutation symmetry, which GRAM does not receive)
metric_definitions.flop_1: coupling assembly of the graph plus chain 0 (mean over test graphs)
metric_definitions.flop_20: coupling assembly plus all 20 chains (mean over test graphs)
